- R2 (X1‑N_b1) = 5 Ω
- R3 (N_b1‑N_b2) = 10 Ω
- R4 (N_b2‑N_b3) = 15 Ω
- R5 (N_b3‑B) = 20 Ω

Thus the circuit is a straight series chain from A to B through these five resistors.</thought>
